# Reason codes and short log fields

Every log row keeps SHORT codes: they are written on every request, and the analyzer, the Logs filters, saved links and old logs depend on
them, so they are never renamed. The admin panel shows the full name next to the code everywhere a reason appears (Logs, Identity, the
dashboard lists), with the explanation as a tooltip. This page is the same list. The Reason filter on the Logs page offers the full
names; its value is still the code.

## Monitor only: the `SH_` prefix

A code that starts with `SH_` (for example `SH_RULE:<id>`, `SH_IPL_BLOCK:<id>`, `SH_403`) is the monitor-only (shadow) form: the guard would have acted, and did nothing. The panel draws a "monitor only" marker on the badge.

## Codes with an id

`RULE:<id>` names an access rule, `IPL_BLOCK:<id>` and `IPL_ALLOW:<id>` name an IP list. The panel resolves the id to the rule or list name and links to it; an id that no longer exists is struck through.

## Reason codes

| Code | Full name | Category | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SH_403` | Block (403) | Rule | A higher-priority rule would have blocked this request; a lower one that is enforced decided what was served. |
| `SH_429` | Rate limit (429) | Rule | A higher-priority rule would have answered 429; a lower one that is enforced decided what was served. |
| `RULE:<id>` | Rule matched | Rule | An access rule (Rules page) matched the request. Its action applies; for a monitor-only rule nothing is done. |
| `SH_challenge` | Challenge | Rule | A higher-priority rule would have challenged this request; a lower one that is enforced decided what was served. |
| `IPL_ALLOW:<id>` | On an allow list | IP list | The address is in an IP allow list (IP lists page). It skips the checks the list exempts. |
| `IPL_BLOCK:<id>` | On a block list | IP list | The address is in an IP block list (IP lists page). An enforced list refuses the request. |
| `BOT_FAKE` | Crawler claim refuted | Bot verification | The User-Agent claims to be a known crawler but reverse DNS refuted it. The pass is revoked and the client is scored like any other (+35). |
| `BOT_UNVERIFIED` | Unverified crawler over its budget | Bot verification | A crawler claim that is not verified used up its shared budget; the request is handled like any other client. |
| `DEV_DAY` | Device over its daily limit | Rate limit | This device sent more requests in the day than limits.device_day allows. |
| `DEV_HOUR` | Device over its hourly limit | Rate limit | This device sent more requests in the hour than limits.device_hour allows. |
| `CAPT_BUDGET` | CAPTCHA budget exceeded | CAPTCHA | The client is over its per-IP CAPTCHA budget; it gets a 429 instead of another CAPTCHA. |
| `CAPT_ESC` | Escalated to CAPTCHA | CAPTCHA | The proof of work looked headless (score at or above captcha.escalate_score), so the client gets a CAPTCHA instead of a token. |
| `FEW_HDR` | Very few headers | Score signal | Fewer than five request headers; real browsers send more (+15). |
| `HP_HIST` | Touched the honeypot before | Score signal | This client requested the hidden honeypot link earlier (+40). |
| `NO_AL` | No Accept-Language on a page | Score signal | A page request without an Accept-Language header; browsers always send one (+15). |
| `NO_SF` | No Sec-Fetch headers | Score signal | A modern browser User-Agent without Sec-Fetch-* headers (+20). |
| `UA_EMPTY` | No User-Agent | Score signal | The request has an empty User-Agent header (+40). |
| `UA_SCRIPT` | Script or library User-Agent | Score signal | The User-Agent names a scripting client such as curl, python-requests, Go or Scrapy (+30). |
| `CAPT_DEGRADED` | CAPTCHA served without Redis | Degraded mode | Redis is down, so attempts cannot be counted; the CAPTCHA carries a heavier proof of work per answer. |
| `RULE_SKIP_DEGRADED` | Rule skipped, no verdict (Redis down) | Degraded mode | Redis could not be read, so the crawler verdict was unknown; a known crawler kept its pass and a rule that skips verified crawlers did not apply. |
| `OVR_CAPTCHA` | Temporary CAPTCHA (override) | Override | An operator set a temporary CAPTCHA on this address or device: it is shown the image test until it holds a CAPTCHA-level token. |
| `OVR_CHALLENGE` | Temporary challenge (override) | Override | An operator set a temporary challenge on this address or device: it is shown the check page until it holds a valid token. |
| `OVR_DENY` | Temporary block (override) | Override | An operator set a temporary block on this address or device: the request is refused with a 403, whatever the enforcement switches say. |
| `TEST` | Test cookie | Other | The request carried the operator test cookie (Settings, test mode); it is challenged on purpose. |

`SH_CAPT_ESC` is the monitor-only form of `CAPT_ESC` (the proof of work looked headless, but CAPTCHA escalation is not enforced).

## Categories

* Rule
* IP list
* Bot verification
* Rate limit
* Token
* Challenge
* CAPTCHA
* Score signal
* Degraded mode
* Override
* Other

## Other short fields of a log row

| Field | Full name | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `act` | Action taken | `allow` Allowed; `challenge` Challenged; `403` Blocked (403); `429` Rate limited (429); `exempt` Exempt path; `allow_bot` Verified crawler passed; `allow_preview` Link preview passed; `allow_override` Allowed by override; `404_hp` Honeypot hit (404); `token_issued` Token issued; `nonce_bad` Bad challenge nonce; `nonce_replay` Challenge replay; `pow_bad` Bad proof of work; `mint_limited` Token minting limited |
| `tok` | Token state | `v` valid token; `m` no token; `b` bad token |
| `ovr` | Operator override | `(empty)` none; `allow` allow override; `deny` deny override; `challenge` temporary challenge; `captcha` temporary CAPTCHA |
| `botv` | Crawler verification | `(empty)` not checked; `ok` verified crawler; `bad` claim refuted |
| `sh` | Monitor only (shadow) | `0` enforced; `1` monitor only |
| `hold` | Measurement holdout | `0` normal; `1` holdout |
| `cap` | CAPTCHA step | `show` shown; `ok` solved; `wrong` wrong answer; `fail` failed; `exp` expired; `inv` invalid; `esc` escalated from proof of work |
| `tl` | Token level | `c` CAPTCHA level |
